title: MSFS Marketplace Update: 3 New Remote & Island Airports Tested (SARE, ZWAT, YKII)
description:
The Microsoft Flight Simulator marketplace just delivered the perfect remedy for stale flight logs with three unique, off-the-beaten-path destinations across three different continents! Whether you want to battle coastal crosswinds on a rugged Australian island, fly regional routes across the plains of northern Argentina, or challenge mountainous approaches in northwest China, there is a brand-new adventure waiting for your virtual flight bag.

In this comprehensive marketplace breakdown, we dive deep into today's major handcrafted airport releases to see which destinations genuinely deserve a spot in your virtual flight logs:

✈️ SOUTH AMERICAN REGIONAL HUB & CHINESE MOUNTAIN GATEWAY: We kick things off in Argentina with Resistencia International Airport (SARE) by new developer Towersoft. Located in the Chaco province, this regional international airport features fully modeled custom terminal buildings, military structures, radar domes, detailed apron and ground textures, updated taxiway markings, and full GSX Pro compatibility. Next, we head over to northwest China for Altay Xuedu International Airport (ZWAT) by MSFSceneryBuilders. Built as a 4C domestic regional tourism gateway capable of handling aircraft up to the Boeing 737-800, this scenery features realistic apron wear-and-tear and authentic airport structures nestled along rugged terrain.

🌏 COASTAL ISLAND GENERAL AVIATION & REGIONAL DESTINATION: Finally, we cross into the Bass Strait to visit King Island Airport (YKII) by Simulación Extrema (developed by Hans). Located off the northwest coast of Tasmania near Currie, Australia, this handcrafted airport delivers high-fidelity 4K PBR textures, a detailed hand-modeled terminal with custom interiors, fuel logistics facilities, factory buildings, 3D ground service equipment, and animated apron life.

Which of these remote destinations are you filing a flight plan for first? Are you taking a 737 into Altay, testing your landing skills in the Bass Strait winds at King Island, or running regional hops out of Resistencia? Let me know in the comments below!

If this structured marketplace breakdown helped you discover your next route, make sure to hit that like button and subscribe for weekly MSFS realism, scenery, and marketplace updates!
